criteria.description: Prompt is preserved byte-for-byte and hash-verified.
Current HEAD, working tree, architecture, gaps and limitations are recorded.
Required checks are explicit, reproducible and green on the candidate commit.
criteria.required_evidence: fresh CI run and local verification ledger

criteria.description: Green Main policy maps required checks, ownership and blocking behavior.
Actions, dependencies, images, SBOMs, provenance and signatures are verifiable.
criteria.required_evidence: workflow/action policy, scanner results, digest and signature verification

criteria.description: One release gate aggregates security, tests, recovery, performance, docs and manifest evidence.
P0 clinical paths have criticality, safety invariants, negative tests and ownership.
criteria.required_evidence: clinical matrix, invariants and executable tests

criteria.description: Jobs are idempotent and have bounded retry, DLQ, lease and replay evidence.
criteria.required_evidence: worker policy, tests and current run evidence

criteria.description: Tenant isolation, RLS, immutable audit and migration safety are verified.
criteria.required_evidence: runtime DB/RLS evidence, audit tests and migration checks

criteria.description: Backup, restore, corruption and migration-mismatch drills meet declared RPO/RTO.
criteria.required_evidence: timed drill artifacts and docs/operations policies

criteria.description: SLOs, error budget, alerts, tracing, retention and on-call routing are proven.
criteria.required_evidence: SLO policy, alert delivery and observability evidence

criteria.description: Critical API, DB, Redis, worker and storage capacity has current target certification.
Critical clinical flows pass responsive, accessibility, visual and usability review.
criteria.required_evidence: real renders, automated checks, independent visual critic and UAT record

criteria.description: Module boundaries, dependency direction and composition root remain enforceable.
Required policies, ADRs, runbooks, scorecard and execution log are synchronized with code.
Final score is objective, no P0 remains, limitations are explicit and no unsupported verified claim is made.
criteria.required_evidence: final scorecard, release evidence, fresh critics and authority record
